name: City Council Special Meeting
minutes_text:
CITY OF AZUSA
  MINUTES OF THE CITY COUNCIL
  SPECIAL MEETING
  MONDAY, DECEMBER 12, 2022 – 6:00 P.M.

REGULAR MEETING

Mayor Gonzales called the meeting to order at 6:00 P.M.

CITY COUNCIL ROLL CALL: Roll call was taken by City Clerk Cornejo.

PRESENT: COUNCILMEMBERS: BECKWITH, AVILA Jr., ALVAREZ, MENDEZ, GONZALES
ABSENT: COUNCILMEMBERS: NONE

ALSO PRESENT

Elected Officials: City Clerk Cornejo.

Staff Members: City Manager Gonzalez, City Attorney Marco, Chief of Police Wenrick, Director of
Administrative Services Johnson, Director of Public Works/City Engineer Delgadillo, Deputy City Manager
DeAnda-Scaia, Director of Community Resources Carpenter, IT and Library Services Director Graf, and Chief
Deputy City Clerk Garcia.

PRELIMINARY BUSINESS

1. Call to Order

2. Roll Call

3. Honor Guard by Azusa Post 8070

4. Pledge to the Flag

5. National Anthem – Pastor Dennis Lamar

6. Invocation – Pastor Bonnie Powell

PUBLIC PARTICIPATION

Alexis Sanchez District Representative from Assemblywoman Blanca Rubio presented Certificate of Recognition.

Sandra Lopez Representative from State Senator Susan Rubio presented Certificate of Recognition.

Ricardo Padilla, Board of Trustees from El Monte School District presented Certificate of Recognition.

RESOLUTION DECLARING GENERAL MUNICIPAL ELECTION RESULTS HELD ON NOVEMBER
8, 2022.

Adopt Resolution No. 2022-C86, reciting the fact of the General Municipal election held on November 8, 2022,
declaring the results and such other matters as provided by law was approved

Motion by Councilmember Avila, seconded by Mayor Pro-Tem Mendez to adopt Resolution No. 2022-C86.

AYES:  COUNCILMEMBERS: BECKWITH, MENDEZ, ALVAREZ, AVILA Jr., GONZALES
NOES:  COUNCILMEMBERS: NONE
ABSTAIN:  COUNCILMEMBERS: NONE
ABSENT:  COUNCILMEMBERS: NONE
 OATHS OF OFFICE, PRESENTATION OF CERTIFICATES OF ELECTION AND SEATING OF
OFFICIALS.

1. Oath of Office to be administered to newly elected officials:

  CITY CLERK – Jeffrey Lawrence Cornejo, Jr.
  CITY TREASURER – Arthur M. Vasquez, Jr.
  COUNCILMEMBER – Dennis Beckwith
  COUNCILMEMBER – Andrew N. Mendez
  COUNCILMEMBER – Edward J. Alvarez
  MAYOR – Robert Gonzales

ADJOURNMENT
  Benediction – Pastor Rick McDonald

TIME OF ADJOURNMENT: 6:58 P.M.

__________________________________________
CITY CLERK
